title.zh: 特权级：CPU 每条指令都查「你现在是谁」
title.en: Privilege levels: the CPU checks who you are on every instruction

description.zh: 在 ring 3 或 EL0 上，读写端口、关中断、换页表的指令一执行就被硬件拦下；Linux 把它变成 SIGSEGV 或 SIGILL。
description.en: At ring 3 or EL0, port I/O, disabling interrupts or switching page tables traps in hardware; Linux turns it into SIGSEGV or SIGILL.

zh: 操作系统怎么和硬件通信
en: how does the OS talk to hardware

title.zh: 系统调用：程序故意触发的一次异常
title.en: The system call: an exception the program raises on purpose

description.zh: syscall 或 svc 把 CPU 切到内核的固定入口；编号放在 rax（arm64 是 x8），内核按编号查表。
description.en: syscall or svc jumps to a fixed kernel entry; the number sits in rax (x8 on arm64) and the kernel looks it up in a table.

title.zh: 一次进出内核要多少周期

description.zh: 进出本身一两百个周期；KPTI 让每次多付几百个，批量才能把门票摊薄。
description.en: The crossing itself is a hundred or two cycles; KPTI adds hundreds more, and only batching spreads the cost.

title.zh: 设备寄存器：物理地址上的一段「假内存」
title.en: Device registers: a stretch of pretend memory

description.zh: 写寄存器发出去就走，读寄存器要等一次 PCIe 来回，约半微秒；所以驱动尽量不读设备。
description.en: A register write is posted; a read waits a PCIe round trip of about half a microsecond, so drivers avoid reading devices.

title.zh: 中断走过的路：向量、上半部、下半部
title.en: The path of an interrupt: vector, top half, bottom half

description.zh: 一次写变成本地 APIC 上的向量号，核心按 IDT 跳进处理函数；上半部只做最急的事，其余交给软中断或中断线程。
description.en: A write becomes a vector at the local APIC, the core jumps through the IDT; the top half does the urgent part, softirqs or threaded handlers do the rest.

title.en: NAPI: interrupt first, then poll in batches

description.zh: 包来得密时每包一次中断会让核心活锁；NAPI 在第一个中断后关掉中断、每次最多轮询 64 个包。
description.en: At high packet rates an interrupt per packet livelocks the core; NAPI masks interrupts after the first and polls up to 64 packets at a time.

description.zh: 驱动在内存里摆一圈描述符，网卡自己把数据写进去；两个只往前走的计数器追上了就满，满了就丢包。
description.en: The driver lays out a ring of descriptors and the NIC writes data into them; two free-running counters meet when it is full, and then packets drop.

description.zh: 设备给出的 I/O 虚拟地址经 IOMMU 翻译，每个设备只看得见映射给它的几页。
description.en: Device addresses are I/O virtual addresses translated by the IOMMU; each device sees only the pages mapped for it.

title.en: The driver model: match, probe, bind

description.zh: 总线把设备的 ID 和驱动的表逐条比对，对上了调用 probe()；缺依赖时返回 -EPROBE_DEFER，等别的绑定成功后重试。
description.en: The bus compares device IDs with each driver table and calls probe() on a match; a missing dependency returns -EPROBE_DEFER and is retried after another bind.

title.zh: 一次 read() 穿过的每一层

description.zh: 页缓存命中不到一微秒；不命中时穿过文件系统、块层和驱动，在最快的盘上软件已经和设备一样慢。
description.en: A page-cache hit takes under a microsecond; a miss crosses the file system, block layer and driver, and on the fastest drives the software is as slow as the device.

title.zh: 少走几次门：epoll 与 io_uring

description.zh: epoll 一次告诉你哪些连接有数据；io_uring 用两个共享的环一次交一批、收一批。
description.en: epoll reports which connections are ready in one call; io_uring uses two shared rings to submit and reap a batch at a time.

title.zh: 绕开内核，以及虚拟机里的设备
title.en: Kernel bypass and devices in virtual machines

description.zh: DPDK、SPDK 和 RDMA 把队列直接交给用户程序；virtio 和 SR-IOV 把设备交给虚拟机。
description.en: DPDK, SPDK and RDMA hand queues straight to a user program; virtio and SR-IOV hand devices to virtual machines.

title.zh: 前沿：io_uring 的安全代价、Rust 驱动、用户态
title.en: The frontier: io_uring security, Rust drivers, user space

description.zh: 2026 年 11 月：io_uring 是内核里最常被攻击的部分之一；Linux 6.18 收进了 Rust 写的 Binder，7.4 删掉了 C 版本。
description.en: November 2026: io_uring is among the most attacked parts of the kernel; Linux 6.18 merged the Rust Binder and 7.4 removed the C one.

title.zh: 程序卡在 I/O 上时问的三件事
title.en: Three questions when a program is stuck on I/O

description.zh: 时间花在链上的哪一段，每次 I/O 走了几次门，CPU 是在干活还是在等。
description.en: Which link of the chain takes the time, how many crossings each I/O makes, and whether the CPU is working or waiting.

label.en: The gate is in the wall

reason.zh: 第 2 章的系统调用，是第 1 章的特权级之间唯一一扇正式的门。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s system call is the one sanctioned gate between chapter 1’s privilege levels.

label.en: What one trip through the gate costs

reason.zh: 第 3 章量的是第 2 章那条 syscall 指令进出一次内核的周期数。
reason.en: Chapter 3 counts the cycles of one round trip through chapter 2’s syscall instruction.

reason.zh: 第 11 章用第 3 章的代价模型，算 epoll 和 io_uring 每次 I/O 省下几次进出内核。
reason.en: Chapter 11 reuses chapter 3’s cost model to count the kernel crossings epoll and io_uring save per I/O.

label.en: Not using the gate at all

reason.zh: 第 12 章按名字沿用第 3 章的模型：绕开内核，省的正是那笔进出的代价。
reason.en: Chapter 12 reuses chapter 3’s model by name: bypassing the kernel saves exactly that crossing cost.

label.en: The doorbell is a register too

reason.zh: 第 7 章的描述符环只在敲门铃时碰设备寄存器，这是第 4 章「读寄存器很贵」的解法。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s descriptor ring touches a device register only to ring the doorbell, the answer to chapter 4’s expensive register reads.

label.en: Too many interrupts, switch to polling

reason.zh: 第 6 章的 NAPI 在第 5 章那条中断路径上加了一个开关：中断来得太勤就关掉它去轮询。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s NAPI adds a switch to chapter 5’s interrupt path: when interrupts come too often, turn them off and poll.

reason.zh: 第 12 章的 DPDK、SPDK 沿用第 6 章的轮询模型，让一个核心一直盯着设备。
reason.en: Chapter 12’s DPDK and SPDK reuse chapter 6’s polling model, with one core watching the device all the time.

label.en: The addresses a device writes are translated

reason.zh: 第 8 章的 IOMMU 翻译的，正是第 7 章描述符里交给设备去 DMA 的地址。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s IOMMU translates exactly the addresses chapter 7’s descriptors hand the device for DMA.

label.zh: 一次 read() 从门开始
label.en: One read() starts at the gate

reason.zh: 第 10 章跟着一次 read() 穿过每一层，第一层就是第 2 章的系统调用。
reason.en: Chapter 10 follows one read() through every layer; the first is chapter 2’s system call.

reason.zh: 第 10 章的 I/O 栈底下，是第 9 章配对好的那个驱动。
reason.en: At the bottom of chapter 10’s I/O stack is the driver chapter 9 bound to the device.

reason.zh: 第 11 章拿第 10 章的 read() 路径，比较阻塞、epoll 和 io_uring 每次 I/O 的系统调用次数。
reason.en: Chapter 11 takes chapter 10’s read() path and compares system calls per I/O for blocking reads, epoll and io_uring.

label.zh: 页表项里的 U/S 位
label.en: The U/S bit in a page-table entry

reason.zh: 第 1 章里用户态读内核地址报缺页，靠的是虚拟内存那篇第 3 章页表项里的权限位。
reason.en: In chapter 1 a user-mode load of a kernel address faults because of the permission bits in the page-table entries of the virtual-memory essay’s chapter 3.

reason.zh: 第 1 章的 EL0–EL3，在开机那篇第 12 章里是一级级交接下来的。
reason.en: Chapter 1’s EL0–EL3 are the levels the boot essay’s chapter 12 hands down one by one.

label.en: First the kernel is brought in

reason.zh: 第 2 章的系统调用入口，是开机那篇第 11 章交接给内核以后才设好的。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s system-call entry is set up only after the boot essay’s chapter 11 hands control to the kernel.

reason.zh: 第 3 章有无 KPTI、PCID 的三档代价，来自虚拟内存那篇第 10 章讲的每次进出多写一次 CR3。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s three cost levels with and without KPTI and PCID come from the extra CR3 write per crossing in the virtual-memory essay’s chapter 10.

label.en: The BAR is that row of registers

reason.zh: 第 4 章读写的设备寄存器，落在 PCIe 那篇第 6 章开机时分给设备的 BAR 窗口里。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s device registers sit in the BAR window PCIe’s chapter 6 assigns at boot.

reason.zh: 第 5 章从 PCIe 那篇第 7 章的 MSI 写入接着走：APIC、IDT、上半部、下半部。
reason.en: Chapter 5 continues from the MSI write of PCIe’s chapter 7: APIC, IDT, top half, bottom half.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的接收环和 NVMe 那篇第 4 章的提交队列、完成队列是同一种结构。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s receive ring is the same structure as the submission and completion queues of the NVMe essay’s chapter 4.

reason.zh: 第 6 章网卡的中断与轮询之争，在 NVMe 那篇第 7 章的固态硬盘上是同一笔账。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s interrupts-versus-polling trade-off for network cards is the same account as for the SSDs of the NVMe essay’s chapter 7.

reason.zh: NVMe 那篇第 7 章提到的 io_uring IOPOLL，接口本身在第 11 章。
reason.en: The io_uring IOPOLL mentioned in the NVMe essay’s chapter 7 is the interface of chapter 11.

reason.zh: 第 7 章驱动在敲门铃之前要一道写屏障，屏障是多核那篇第 9 章讲的。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s driver needs a write barrier before ringing the doorbell; barriers are in the cores essay’s chapter 9.

reason.zh: 第 8 章只讲重映射；雷电那篇第 8 章讲它按页开门时漏掉了什么。
reason.en: Chapter 8 covers remapping only; Thunderbolt’s chapter 8 covers what page-sized windows let through.

reason.zh: 虚拟内存那篇第 11 章说 IOMMU 是给设备的页表，第 8 章讲驱动怎样往里填。
reason.en: The virtual-memory essay’s chapter 11 calls the IOMMU a page table for devices; chapter 8 shows how the driver fills it.

reason.zh: 第 9 章按厂商号、设备号、类别码配对驱动，这些值是 PCIe 那篇第 6 章开机点名时读出来的。
reason.en: Chapter 9 matches drivers on vendor, device and class codes that PCIe’s chapter 6 reads during the roll call.

reason.zh: 第 9 章不在 PCIe 上的设备，来自开机那篇第 6 章固件交出的 ACPI 表。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s devices that are not on PCIe come from the ACPI tables the boot essay’s chapter 6 hands over.

reason.zh: 开机那篇第 11 章的初始内存盘装着找到硬盘所需的驱动，它们怎样认出设备见第 9 章。
reason.en: The initramfs of the boot essay’s chapter 11 carries the drivers needed to find the disk; chapter 9 shows how they find their devices.

label.en: It ends as a block number

reason.zh: 第 10 章的 read() 在块层变成硬盘那篇第 1 章的逻辑块号。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s read() becomes a logical block address, as in the drive essay’s chapter 1, at the block layer.

reason.zh: 隔着网线的硬盘第 6 章的 RDMA 是跨机器的内核旁路；第 12 章讲一台机器里的几种绕法。
reason.en: RDMA in chapter 6 of the network-storage essay is kernel bypass between machines; chapter 12 covers the ways round the kernel inside one machine.
